scope: Quality-gated path toward a polished original premium archery roguelite. AAA is an aspiration, not a certified rating, budget or delivery promise. Public-only content.

tasks.title: Pinned A-Frame scene and same-origin assets
tasks.gate: Renderer starts and all runtime requests stay same-origin.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Start reliably without depending on remote runtime assets.

tasks.title: Two-hand draw, nock and pose-loss cancellation
tasks.gate: Real controller poses produce direction and power; losses never fire a stale arrow.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: The shot must follow the real draw, including cancellation under tracking loss.

tasks.title: Swept arrows, cover and limited special ammunition
tasks.gate: Hits stop at nearest geometry and ammo changes only on valid shots.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Precision is meaningful only when hits and cover are consistent.

tasks.title: Blink arrows and opt-in stick locomotion
tasks.gate: Shared projectile/preview first-hit collision; a widened upper-gallery target. A clear preview is not automatic aiming or permission to pass through solids.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Connected seeded cloisters and branching paths
tasks.gate: 25 seeded districts with nonuniform plans, connected ground approaches and reversible elevated loops. Same seed/depth reproduces the layout. No streaming-world claim.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Wardens, beacon, blessings and local renown
tasks.gate: An ordinary-input mission reaches the next sector; completion cannot be banked twice.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Spatial pause, handedness and shorter draw
tasks.gate: All essential actions can be completed in-headset, with cancelled inputs on transitions.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Quest 3 bow alignment and physical draw feel
tasks.gate: Record actual headset/browser version and both handedness tests. No API fixture substitutes.
tasks.verification: No physical device receipt yet.
tasks.why: A software fixture cannot tell us how a person feels or how a real device sustains the experience.

tasks.title: Quest 3 sustained rendering and comfort
tasks.gate: Measure frame-time distribution, draw calls, thermal behavior, floor and snap turning on hardware.
tasks.verification: No physical device receipt yet.
tasks.why: A software fixture cannot tell us how a person feels or how a real device sustains the experience.

tasks.title: Real Xbox and touch controllers
tasks.gate: Pair, reconnect, suspend and resume real USB/Bluetooth controllers and a phone.
tasks.verification: No physical device receipt yet.
tasks.why: A software fixture cannot tell us how a person feels or how a real device sustains the experience.

tasks.title: Six room families, reversible skywalk and two-level belfry
tasks.gate: Six inner architecture families and sixteen outer district families, reversible skywalks and playable 6.4m belfries. Geometry and routes are tested separately from human enjoyment.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Crossbow, deliberate timed reload and independent weapon model
tasks.gate: Loaded/empty state and timed button reload are preserved alongside the physical winding interaction. No weapon-swap refill.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Shield weak points and coordinated enemy behavior
tasks.gate: Directional guard and weak-point counterplay exist. Group attack coordination, fair ranged/melee overlap and offscreen threat budgets still need an encounter director.
tasks.verification: Individual enemies tested; encounter-direction gate remains open.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Refined original creatures, bow animation and spatial audio
tasks.gate: Spatial sound, reflective equipment and readable procedural creatures exist. Authored rigged enemy/hand assets, animation blending and polished reactions remain open.
tasks.verification: Audio and procedural art implemented; character-production and human-review gates open.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Pilgrim's Rest: save and continue a complete scored expedition
tasks.gate: Regenerate the exact world; restore enemies, supplies, projectiles, equipment and timers; preserve banked receipts in one bounded envelope. Continue waits paused. Practice/AR cannot overwrite scored saves.
tasks.verification: Model and native browser/controller release gates; physical lifecycle QA remains open.
tasks.why: Long exploration needs interruption-safe continuity, not just permanent unlocks.

tasks.title: Player evaluation of difficulty and enjoyment
tasks.gate: Record first-run usability, fatigue and repeat-play feedback; counts do not certify fun.
tasks.verification: Not closed.
tasks.why: A software fixture cannot tell us how a person feels or how a real device sustains the experience.

tasks.title: Optional opt-in challenge sharing
tasks.gate: No accounts or remote data until explicitly designed and authorized.
tasks.verification: Not closed.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Directional Wardglass shield, break and recovery
tasks.gate: Front-face swept blocking before body impact; side/rear exposure, guard cost, tracking cancellation and no simultaneous firing.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Regenerating supported-ground shard steps
tasks.gate: Short unobstructed microdashes, no cliff crossing or tunneling. Physical thrown-shard gestures are not implemented.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Limited three-arrow Volley and precision hits
tasks.gate: Three independent projectiles consume one charge; actual weak-point hits earn counters.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Permanent Chronicle milestones and optional Nightfall
tasks.gate: Idempotent run-counter banking, retained legacy purchases, no practice farming and new-run application.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Twilight/daylight, original equipment and quiet synthetic ambience
tasks.gate: Twilight/daylight and original equipment remain. Five synthesized score arrangements and bounded spatial sound now replace the minimal ambience; independent mix controls and explicit mute are preserved.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Complete scored expedition and new-device acceptance
tasks.gate: Ordinary-input scored expeditions, beacon blessings and persistent rewards have software coverage. Real-device reconnection, comfort, endurance and broad seed/device matrices remain open.
tasks.verification: Software coverage exists; physical/new-device acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Physical thrown shard and richer vertical route families
tasks.gate: Readable trajectories, safe valid landings, comfortable two-handed controls and alternative routes; no forced headset motion.
tasks.verification: Not closed.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Physical crossbow wind/reload gesture
tasks.gate: Tracked near-handle grab, backward pull and release latch the crossbow. Short-draw and stick-click alternatives remain; tracking loss cancels.
tasks.verification: Model and emulated-controller tests; ergonomic gate V08 remains open.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Hollow Hunt: committed cantor volleys, hound charges and sentinel guard
tasks.gate: Shared physical projectiles/collision, visible warning, dodge/block/counterplay, no homing charge.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Two optional double-stair loft loops and elevation-gated caches
tasks.gate: Preserve ground graph links; walk both stairways and collect upper supply only at its elevation.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Three repeatable adversary trials and field guide
tasks.gate: Ordinary menus spawn real AI. Trial counters never change the Chronicle or prior purchases.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Surface-triggered Cinder bursts and interrupting Frost
tasks.gate: Cover occludes area damage; freeze interrupts charges and has a shorter sentinel duration.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Physical interaction follow-through: winding complete; shard throwing open
tasks.gate: V25 covers shipped crossbow winding. V24 still owns a physical thrown-shard implementation and real-hardware evaluation. Do not count this umbrella twice.
tasks.verification: Split scope; thrown shard not implemented.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: CC0 castle masonry, cobbles and finished marble sculpture
tasks.gate: Local 1K material maps and embedded 512px GLB textures; author/source/license/transform/hash register; no runtime CDN.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Inter-room upper loop and 6.4m belfry reliquaries
tasks.gate: One-time, elevation-gated score/heal rewards, reversible traversal and ground alternatives. Trial play cannot farm permanent rewards.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Continuous arch profiles, roof silhouettes and spatial material batches
tasks.gate: Matching actual before/after frames; static shadows refreshed on rebuild rather than each frame. Physical Quest performance remains unmeasured.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Scaled floorplan atlas with upper route and reward cues
tasks.gate: Use actual room outlines, gold skywalk and reliquary markers. No player steering or auto-completion.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Authored crypt/roof transitions and expanded graph vocabulary
tasks.gate: 25-district graph expansion shipped. Distinct authored crypt-to-roof transitions and stronger route grammar still need design and native traversal evidence.
tasks.verification: Expanded graph implemented; authored transition production remains open.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Hardware and human review of the material-rich vertical world
tasks.gate: Quest 3 controller/floor calibration, sustained frame times, memory, comfort and whether players find the climbs worthwhile. API emulation cannot close this gate.
tasks.verification: No physical device receipt yet.
tasks.why: A software fixture cannot tell us how a person feels or how a real device sustains the experience.

tasks.title: Jewelglass material profiles, carved recurve and bounded spell shaders
tasks.gate: Native material, rebuild and emulated stereo tests plus actual served-file verification.
tasks.verification: Source implemented; software regression coverage. Physical acceptance is separate.
tasks.why: Preserve the established game while closing the stated acceptance gate.

tasks.title: Measure physical Quest 3 stereo frame times for jewel reflections and shaders
tasks.gate: Measure on device; never infer FPS, comfort or controller alignment from headless emulation.
tasks.verification: No physical device receipt yet.
tasks.why: A software fixture cannot tell us how a person feels or how a real device sustains the experience.

tasks.title: Hollow Dominions: outer districts, high walks and optional crowns
tasks.gate: Retain 25 districts, 16 outer galleries, additional reversible upper connections and optional exploration rewards. Core five wardens still unlock the exit.
tasks.why: Offer alternate approaches and worthwhile vertical exploration.
tasks.verification: Software release evidence; hardware and human gates remain separate.

tasks.title: Twelve additional enemy orders and repeatable trials
tasks.gate: Fifteen total archetypes with distinct windups, committed attacks, damage and counterplay; each added order can be practiced.
tasks.why: Variety must change decisions rather than only appearance.
tasks.verification: Software release evidence; hardware and human gates remain separate.

tasks.title: Xbox focus navigation and paginated Quest spatial menus
tasks.gate: Gameplay, settings, seeds, equipment, journal and in-game dialogs can be operated with controller input. System permission prompts are not game-owned.
tasks.why: Avoid forced mouse use or headset removal.
tasks.verification: Software release evidence; hardware and human gates remain separate.

tasks.title: Stationary passthrough AR Sanctuary and expedition restoration
tasks.gate: An immersive-ar session creates an unscored stationary arena, disables artificial travel and restores the paused VR/browser expedition on exit. No furniture scanning or real-world occlusion.
tasks.why: Make AR an explicit supported alternative without silently pretending it is the full VR world.
tasks.verification: Software release evidence; hardware and human gates remain separate.

tasks.title: Resonant Hunt: adaptive score and spatial combat vocabulary
tasks.gate: Five original synthesized arrangements; positioned and distance/obstruction-aware effects; warning-driven music ducking; bounded voices and no hidden-tab backlog.
tasks.why: Atmosphere and directional warnings should support precision instead of masking it.
tasks.verification: Software release evidence; hardware and human gates remain separate.

tasks.title: Independent sound mix, quiet option and captions
tasks.gate: Separate music/effects/ambience/master controls are available on Xbox and Quest; explicit mute persists. Captions remain available.
tasks.why: Let players control sensory intensity rather than forcing an overwhelming mix.
tasks.verification: Software release evidence; hardware and human gates remain separate.

tasks.title: Palm familiar, physical pickups and tactical quiver
tasks.gate: Palm-up status, near-hand trigger pulls, six-arrow selection and a three-second slow-time reserve work without slowing headset tracking.
tasks.why: Move information and decisions into the physical archery loop.
tasks.verification: Software release evidence; hardware and human gates remain separate.

tasks.title: Finite Ricochet arrows and Mirror Thread unlock
tasks.gate: At most two swept wall reflections; finite ammunition; 20 banked real hits unlock future loot. Practice never grants the unlock.
tasks.why: Add another tactical option with an earned long-term goal.
tasks.verification: Software release evidence; hardware and human gates remain separate.

tasks.title: Atomic profile/checkpoint receipt and damaged-save recovery
tasks.gate: An integrity-checked envelope stores progression and banking receipts together. Quota failures are visible, stale tabs yield, and explicit discard retains permanent progress.
tasks.why: Avoid reward duplication, silent data loss and accidental overwrites.
tasks.verification: Software release evidence; hardware and human gates remain separate.

tasks.title: Versioned production board and six-sheet workbook
tasks.gate: roadmap.json is canonical; board and workbook show priority, dependencies, owner role, evidence and exit gates. Local edits are clearly separate from committed status.
tasks.why: Make each release close a measurable gap and keep the long-term path inspectable.
tasks.verification: Software release evidence; hardware and human gates remain separate.

tasks.title: First ten minutes: playable physical onboarding
tasks.gate: A new player can learn nock/draw, cancel, reload, shield, Blink, shard step, pickups and quiver in either handedness, then enter a short scored encounter. Record completion, confusion and fatigue.
tasks.why: A feature-rich control scheme is not yet an intuitive first session.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Encounter director with fair threat and recovery budgets
tasks.gate: Coordinate telegraphed melee/ranged attacks, limit unavoidable overlap and offscreen attacks, preserve escape routes and add recovery beats. Replay fixed-seed stress encounters.
tasks.why: Fifteen archetypes need readable group pacing, not simultaneous noise.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: First signature boss: readable multi-phase duel
tasks.gate: An original boss changes tactics across three tested phases, uses cover/height, offers weak-point windows and has no unavoidable transition damage or restart softlock.
tasks.why: Create a memorable mastery test rather than another enlarged standard enemy.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Authored vertical-slice route grammar and route contracts
tasks.gate: One polished 20-30 minute target route mixes safe introduction, alternate approach, escalating encounter, discovery and boss payoff. Validate every traversal connector and recovery path. Duration is a design target, not measured content.
tasks.why: Replace sheer room count with deliberately paced exploration.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Meaningful run builds and loot-choice balance
tasks.gate: At least three viable archery build identities create distinct trade-offs; costs, loot odds and special-arrow counters are documented and tested. No mandatory grind to access basic controls.
tasks.why: Give repeated runs a changing strategy and satisfying decisions.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Original rigged enemy, bow-hand and shield production assets
tasks.gate: Produce consistent original/licensed meshes, LODs, rigs and materials for one complete vertical slice; registered provenance; review both eye views and close-range silhouette.
tasks.why: Foreground and character quality must catch up with the architecture.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Animation transitions, reactions and archery weight
tasks.gate: Blend idle/locomotion/windup/recovery/hit/death clips; grounded contact and readable hands; reactions never hide the true hitbox or cancel a valid counter.
tasks.why: Make enemies and weapons feel physical instead of procedural placeholders.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Three strongly differentiated biome packages
tasks.gate: Complete coherent crypt, storm roof and luminous sanctuary kits with different navigation, encounter opportunities, materials and sonic palettes. Validate seed combinations and repeated transitions.
tasks.why: Different sectors should feel like places, not palette swaps.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Original environmental narrative and reward presentation
tasks.gate: Public-only lore, landmarks and discoveries connect the world; skippable/accessible presentation; no private story content enters this repository without permission.
tasks.why: Give exploration emotional meaning and recognizable destinations.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Long-session headphone mix and notification-rate controls
tasks.gate: Add independent notification density/rate controls; test 30-minute sessions with music transitions, simultaneous threats and repeated UI actions. Record human mix feedback and remove tiring repetition.
tasks.why: Bounded voices alone do not guarantee pleasant sound.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Quest 3 measured frame-time and thermal budget
tasks.gate: Capture 30-minute native Quest traces with scene, headset/browser version, frame-time percentiles, dropped frames and thermal observations. Proposed minimum 72 Hz target: p95 CPU and GPU each under 13.89 ms; 90 Hz mode targets 11.11 ms. Targets are not current measurements.
tasks.why: Only measured device performance can close the performance gate.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: World batching, distance detail and memory stability
tasks.gate: Profile first, then budget visibility/batching/LODs and allocation. Ten rebuilds and VR/AR cycles show bounded memory and no steadily growing resources; visual quality remains readable.
tasks.why: Optimize the bottleneck actually observed on the target headset.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Full remapping, seated/reach calibration and comfort presets
tasks.gate: Configurable action mapping with conflict checks, seated/standing height and reach calibration, turn/motion presets and readable UI. Each can be reset without a mouse.
tasks.why: Different bodies and play spaces need more than a handedness toggle.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Physical Xbox/Quest/phone lifecycle matrix
tasks.gate: Real USB/Bluetooth Xbox and both Quest hands pass pairing, disconnect during draw, visibility loss, denied permission, tracking interruption, save/continue and AR round trips. Record device/build/results.
tasks.why: Emulated button events cannot certify actual hardware integration.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Accessible subtitles, contrast and non-color threat cues
tasks.gate: Text size/contrast, sound direction captions, color-independent ammunition/enemy signals and reduced-flash mode survive desktop, stereo and passthrough contexts. Human accessibility review required.
tasks.why: Threats and menus must remain readable beyond one ideal user.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Human difficulty, discovery and repeat-play study
tasks.gate: Record at least 8 external playtest sessions as a proposed first research batch, including new/experienced players. Track task success, deaths, confusion, route discovery, fatigue and whether they choose another run. No automated score substitutes.
tasks.why: Test whether the experience is enjoyable and understandable.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Save migration, backup/export and upgrade compatibility
tasks.gate: Keep fixtures for old supported generator/schema versions, offer explicit local backup/restore and verify interrupted writes, browser quota and update migration. Never silently reset incompatible saves.
tasks.why: A published game needs durable progress across later upgrades.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Broad seeded soak and repeated-session fault injection
tasks.gate: Run at least 1000 proposed seed/depth fixtures and 50 lifecycle transitions, tracking unreachable rewards, spawning collisions, NaNs, leaks and progress duplication. Publish failures and seed repros.
tasks.why: Finite smoke tests are not a complete campaign quality gate.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Cross-browser visuals and controller release matrix
tasks.gate: Maintain tested desktop Chrome/Edge/Firefox/Safari and target XR-browser configurations where APIs are supported. Unsupported modes explain themselves; all supported essential UI actions pass.
tasks.why: A browser release must be clear about what actually works where.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Release discipline, reproducible builds and rollback
tasks.gate: Byte-verified deployment already exists. Add explicit stable/candidate policy, save-safe rollback drill, reproducible asset pipeline and release-note/device-evidence review.
tasks.why: Do not confuse a merged commit with a complete verified release.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Complete asset-rights, attribution and content audit
tasks.gate: Every shipped mesh, texture, sound, font usage and narrative element has clear provenance/license and accessible attribution. Do not publish borrowed commercial game assets or private writing.
tasks.why: A production release needs a traceable asset pipeline.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Content-complete campaign and replay challenge tuning
tasks.gate: Complete the agreed campaign scope, enemy/loot combinations and endgame variations with no placeholder gates. Measure real play length and review progression fatigue before promising duration.
tasks.why: Finish and balance the agreed experience before expanding scope again.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Beta blocking-bug and regression exit gate
tasks.gate: No unresolved save-loss, crash, softlock or input-blocking defects in supported modes. Regressions are replayed on the final build; remaining nonblocking issues are documented.
tasks.why: A release candidate should be stable, not just feature complete.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Optional shareable challenges or online services
tasks.gate: Start only after explicit design/authorization. Define moderation, consent, accounts, persistence, cost and fair-score limits; never quietly add telemetry or payments.
tasks.why: Protect the local single-player loop from uncontrolled service scope.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Final public launch, support and rollback evidence
tasks.gate: Fresh browser and real headset users can discover/start/continue the game. All public assets match release hashes; QA reports, known issues, controls and support/rollback instructions are published.
tasks.why: A player-facing release is a tested service experience, not a repository label.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Technical debt: separate model, input, presentation and lifecycle
tasks.gate: Reduce wrapper-order coupling with explicit lifecycle interfaces and dependency tests; preserve current save fixtures, deterministic physics and controller mappings.
tasks.why: Repeated additive patches increase the risk of hidden lifecycle regressions.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: Checkpoint user lifecycle on physical devices
tasks.gate: Test headset sleep, browser eviction, offline launch where supported, simultaneous tabs, blocked storage and continued 6.4m-floor saves using real devices. Confirm the paused return is comfortable.
tasks.why: Native automation covers behavior, not headset suspension and comfort.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

tasks.title: First boss and encounter slice end-to-end release
tasks.gate: Publish one complete integrated slice, including onboarding, traversal, encounter pacing, boss payoff and saved continuation; collect human feedback before producing additional bosses.
tasks.why: Concentrate production effort on one excellent experience instead of many unfinished systems.
tasks.verification: Not closed; no completion credit without gate evidence.

milestones.name: Playable foundations
milestones.goal: Retain the shipped original browser/VR/AR foundation.
milestones.exit: Current foundation and input/model/public deployment tests pass; hardware acceptance is not implied.

milestones.name: Reliable first-session slice
milestones.goal: Continue safely and teach the physical loop.
milestones.exit: Saved expeditions, recovery, controller-first menus and tested first-ten-minute onboarding are complete.

milestones.name: Combat mastery slice
milestones.goal: Turn mechanics into a deliberately paced signature adventure.
milestones.exit: Coordinated encounters, authored route grammar, first boss and viable run choices survive native and human playtests.

milestones.name: Production art and content identity
milestones.goal: Replace unfinished assets and establish distinct places and sound.
milestones.exit: Original rigged foreground/enemy art, animation, three coherent biome kits, public narrative and long-session audio review.

milestones.name: Target-device performance and access
milestones.goal: Measure and tune the real Quest/Xbox/browser experience.
milestones.exit: Recorded device matrix, sustained frame-time traces, lifecycle tests, accessibility and stable resource use. Work may run alongside M2/M3.

milestones.name: Content-complete alpha and measured beta
milestones.goal: Finish the agreed scope and test its reliability and appeal.
milestones.exit: Campaign/content completion, save migration, seeded soaks, external playtests, asset audit and cross-browser QA.

milestones.name: Release candidate and supported launch
milestones.goal: Ship a stable and supportable finished game.
milestones.exit: No blocking defects, final physical acceptance, byte-verified launch, known-issues documentation and rehearsed save-safe rollback.

deviceQA: Draw, cancel, physical/button reload, shield, quiver and pickup pull
Record headset OS, browser, build hash, reach setting and session notes.
30-minute worst-case combat/route trace; p95 CPU/GPU under 13.89 ms proposed target
Record actual refresh mode, percentiles, missed frames, memory and heat.
Only enable after measured p95 CPU/GPU under 11.11 ms at agreed visual quality
A software GPU or frame counter is not proof of native refresh.
Clear space, permission denial, safe stationary controls and expedition restoration
Record real passthrough visibility; no real-world occlusion claim.
Suspend while drawing, hide/unhide, end session, continue checkpoint and floor alignment
No stale release, accidental movement or loss of progress.
All actions, menus, dialogs, seed entry, save/continue and reconnect during draw
Record OS, browser and physical controller model/connection.
Supported browser launch, input, audio gesture, save recovery and explicit unsupported XR messages
Specify actual tested versions; do not assume every browser offers XR.
Launch, touch aim/shoot, UI scrolling, quiver and save continuation
Record phone/browser, viewport, touch conflicts and readability.
Comfort presets, remapping, contrast, reduced effects and non-color warnings
Recruit users with varied needs; emulation cannot close human review.
Failures are visible, no silent overwrite, explicit recovery and profile retention
Native software plus unit fault injection; repeat on devices.
releaseGates: Only reviewed game paths change; exact source/build is identified; private story excluded.
Syntax and all current model suites pass; no tunneling, duplicated rewards or nonfinite state.
Native Xbox and stereo-XR fixtures pass; essential actions have no mouse-only dead end.
Checkpoint reload, partial projectiles/timers, practice/AR isolation, conflict and corrupt-storage recovery pass.
Native WebGL and stereo audio checks pass; no script errors, broken asset loads or repeating hidden-tab backlog.
All public runtime/asset/roadmap/workbook bytes match; public homepage launch and relevant live browser checks pass.
Supported device scenarios have dated build-specific receipts, including sustained Quest frame-time traces.
Onboarding, challenge, fatigue, sound balance and repeat-play feedback are recorded and blocking concerns resolved.
Agreed scope complete, rights/provenance checked, public-only narrative and no placeholder blocking flow.
No blocking defects; tested rollback preserves supported saves; known issues and support instructions are published.
risks: Run the device trace before adding more expensive visual effects.
Large feature count without a polished signature slice
Many procedural rooms do not establish quality
Finish one cohesive onboarding-to-boss route before expanding content.
Several modules wrap the same component methods
Refactor explicit lifecycle contracts with preserved regression fixtures.
Browser storage eviction and future generator changes
Local saves are not cloud backup; only current generator supported
Publish limitations; add migration/backup fixtures before incompatible changes.
Sound fatigue and simultaneous warning overload
Algorithmic limits cannot replace listening sessions
Notification density settings plus 30-minute listening feedback.
Character asset and animation production capacity
Finished consistent rigged assets are incomplete
Define one vertical-slice asset budget and provenance pipeline.
Previous board remained at 0.6 after 0.8 shipped
Check version consistency and preserve one canonical JSON plus generated workbook snapshot.
Simultaneous-tab races or manual local tampering
Local optimistic checks are not server locks or anti-cheat
Pause stale tabs and document local-only integrity; do not claim secure competitive scores.
External services create unplanned data and cost obligations
Keep deferred pending explicit product design and authorization.
No budget, staffing or hardware/human finish criteria have been certified
Track concrete quality gates; never turn completed task count into an AAA rating.

nextRelease.note: Proposed sequence; finish onboarding and coordinated encounters before expanding boss/content count.
